title: Covariate-Adjusted Inverse-Censoring-Weighted Inference for Spectral Survival Panels with Donors
banked_reason: The limit law and bands are proved only for fixed dimensions, exact rank, exact post-transport, and independent equal-K samples in every cell.
gap_reasons: The limit law and bands are proved only for fixed dimensions, exact rank, exact post-transport, and independent equal-K samples in every cell
The load-bearing AIPCW expansion assumes the proof-tailored condition that the total variation of Q/Qhat-1 is O_P(a_K)
No bounded in-scope D0 root repair can restore a field-tier PASS.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the fixed-cell AIPCW expansion under an explicit finite-stratum learner certificate, propagated all three input blocks through the truncated-pseudoinverse map, obtained singular-covariance simultaneous and grid-RMST inference, and repaired the KM/PCR inconsistency witness as a full-data causal law. The mathematics passed review, but the result reached only subfield novelty because it retains fixed dimensions, exact transport/rank, independent equal-size cells, and a strong path-variation rate; reaching field requires a new dependent unequal-cell sampling theory or a concrete continuous-time, continuous-covariate learner theory.
tldr: For fixed donor count, pre grid, post grid, and exact rank of the fixed donor-pre matrix, the required positive rank-\(r\) separation follows from \(\sigma_r(M)>0=\sigma_{r+1}(M)\); no additional singular-gap assumption is imposed. Covariate-adjusted cross-fitted AIPCW cell estimates have a joint root-\(K\) expansion conditional on explicit bounded-variation and relative-variation restrictions for the selected event learner. A clipped empirical hazard learner satisfies those restrictions with \(a_K=K^{-1/2}\) on a fixed finite-stratum submodel, but this certificate is not a generic learner result and does not verify the TCL application. Exact post-transport, without a global target-pre row-space assumption, identifies the untreated potential curve with the observed-law spectral representation. The full three-block spectral derivative yields a possibly singular joint Gaussian law; positive coordinate variances suffice for the simultaneous band and a positive grid-RMST variance suffices for scalar studentization. A full-data causal construction, preserving all six observed margins, proves that unadjusted Kaplan--Meier/PCR has fixed bias on a relatively open subclass. Weak-gap and selected-rank inference remains open.
gap: Synthetic Survival Control identifies a clinically relevant low-rank counterfactual but assumes non-informative censoring and provides no influence-function limit law, while modern orthogonal survival estimators stop before the learned panel map.
fill: The project fixes the score and tie convention, proves its joint product-rate expansion, derives the complete transported influence vector, validates multiplier and grid-RMST inference, and derives the unadjusted workflow's probability limit with an explicit relatively open nonzero-bias subclass.
